title: About Us
yoast_desc: Meet myHoneymoon: luxury honeymoon specialists in Greece with 20+ years of bespoke travel planning.
text_blocks: How we design your bespoke honeymoon
Because your honeymoon is more than just a holiday …
My team and I will help you plan a romantic retreat that’s tailored to your specific requirements – here’s how we design your bespoke honeymoon

Hello. I’m Angeliki, a seasoned travel expert and tour guide with more than 20 years’ experience planning unforgettable honeymoons. If you’re looking for a honeymoon in Greece that’s completely tailored to your unique tastes, you’ve come to the right place. Whether you’d like to escape to a high-end eco retreat, embark on a chic island getaway or explore Greece’s vibrant capital, we curate luxury getaways with your every want and need in mind.
“I want the perfect personalised honeymoon – but I just don’t have the time!”

Your honeymoon is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. It’s your time to nurture the emotional and physical connection that brought you together at the very beginning. But planning a great wedding is hard work. You want everything to be perfect for you and your guests, often leaving you too exhausted to plan a truly memorable honeymoon as well as your big day. Many people opt for a package holiday that doesn’t deliver the idyllic start to married life they’ve always dreamed of. We take the stress out of honeymoon planning, handling everything from flights to accommodation to your daily itinerary. All you need to do is tell us what you’re dreaming of and we’ll make it come to life.
Let’s get to know each other a little better, shall we?
Why honeymoon travel is my passion

I’ve loved to travel since I was a child. It all started during a family road trip when I was just five years old. My father and I toured Italy, Austria and Switzerland, tracking our location on a map as we travelled. It was fascinating to see the names and lines on the page come to life in front of us and I knew the world of travel was where my future lay.

Now, I’m a licensed premium tour guide in Greece, specialising in exclusive culinary tours designed to delight the senses. I’ve planned more than 500 travel itineraries over the last decade, so you’re in very safe hands with me. myHoneymoon was set up in 2015 as a specialist honeymoon design agency for Greek couples, and we’ve recently expanded to offer upscale honeymoons in Greece for newly-weds in the UK and US. There are plenty of romantic activities to enjoy in Greece, whether you’re strolling around a medieval castle, enjoying a Champagne picnic with a view or sitting down to dinner just metres from the Aegean Sea. But if you’re looking for something more unusual, I can make even the most niche requests reality. My job is to make your honeymoon just right, whatever that means to you. I’m proud to call Greece home. I have lived in Italy and Cuba and love to travel the world, but my home country holds a special place in my heart. I was born in Thessaloniki in Northern Greece and have lived in a number of incredible places across the country, including Corfu Island, Chios Island and the Peloponnese. Now, I’ve settled in the vibrant capital of Athens, and love exploring everything the city has to offer. Every time I plan an unforgettable honeymoon for my newly-weds, I experience the entire trip in my mind first. I’m an explorer at heart and I’m always looking out for the most romantic experiences wherever I go. I’ve discovered places that will linger in your mind and light up your senses long after you’ve left. Just close your eyes and you’ll return to a haven of incredible beauty and romance.
Are we a perfect match?
Get to know me better

A key part of our service is taking the time to get to know every one of our special couples to find out what Greek paradise looks like for you. I want you to feel comfortable sharing your most intimate requests with me, so here is a bit more about who I am:
“A honeymoon is like opening a brand-new set of Lego. When a child gets Legos, he certainly doesn't expect to find the finished model in the box. The whole point of Lego is to build.”
JULI SLATTERY, "One Flesh: Sexual Intimacy in Marriage", Ready to Wed

Your Luxury Honeymoon in Greece
Your honeymoon should be the trip of a lifetime. You don’t want to return with regrets like:

“I wish our honeymoon had been more personal.” “I wish we’d planned a better itinerary. We didn’t get to see everything we wanted and ended up rushing around.” “I wish we’d picked more unique accommodation that gave us a chance to enjoy the dream getaway.”

Working with myHoneymoon to plan a bespoke, luxury honeymoon in Greece will take away all the stress. We’ll make sure your break is memorable for all the right reasons, no matter what you’re looking for. Whether you’re seeking a beach holiday on the Greek Islands, a chic city break in Athens or a blissful retreat far from the beaten track, we’ll use our 20 plus years of experience to help. Looking for a bespoke honeymoon in Greece? We can add that personal touch to every part of your holiday, from your accommodation to the activities that fill your day. Want to share a romantic dinner overlooking the Aegean or Ionian Sea or immerse yourself in Greece’s rich history? Fancy staying at an agrotourism farm or a five-star boutique hotel? Your wish is our command. You tell us what you’re looking for and we’ll make it happen. If your dream honeymoon means savouring quality time together in total seclusion, we’ll craft a romantic retreat with you in mind. Or if you want to soak up lots of culture, without feeling like you’re rushing from one place to the next, we can create a bespoke itinerary that offers the perfect balance of relaxation and excitement.
Ready to get started? Let’s plan your perfect honeymoon together

You arrive at your destination, greeted by the salty tang of the seawater and the weathered smiles of local fishermen. Quaint shops line the narrow, sun-bleached streets, each holding gifts that will remind you of your break in paradise. And when you venture to the highest points, you’re treated to incredible views across miles of deep, blue sea and rugged landscapes. If you take a chance and step away from the beaten track, you’ll discover incredible places to reconnect and strengthen your incredible bond. As the birds chirp and the gentle sound of waves caresses you into a deep sleep, you’ll be delighted you chose a truly personal honeymoon experience.
